reasons: The cited text supports the deviation: original 4(a) makes Company's ownership of the Works contingent on invoices being issued and paid and contains no express assignment, which falls short of the preferred position (Customer owns deliverables, Vendor assigns).

The redline reaches the playbook position: vesting on creation plus an irrevocable assignment in p0017, adding 'irrevocable' and 'worldwide' to the embedded Contractor's Information licence in p0021, and a new (e) confirming Company ownership of Company Data and pre-existing IP with an express no-joint-ownership sentence.
Contractor's retained proprietary tools/platform (4(b)) are left untouched, consistent with the guidance that Vendor keeping ownership of its own IP is acceptable.

The failed 'minimal edit p0017' check is advisory only; removing the payment-conditioned ownership carve-out and inserting an express assignment necessarily rewrites that sentence, and the defined-term list and surrounding language are preserved.

Comment is accurate, correctly prefixed, in the required tone, states what changed and why, and offers a sensible fallback (payment-triggered assignment with an interim perpetual, irrevocable licence).
